source_evidence: Player exact 'If I do, will you withdraw your demand for the armory keys?' seeks explicit conditional commitment on commander's own proposed compromise, not a new unconditional concession. Commander confirms yes subject to actual guild agreement with lawful rapid release protocol and accountable authorized officer; promises to rescind signed unilateral instruction and publicly confirm guild custody once agreement secured. Agrees to hold demand in abeyance while V consults guild. Prior successful DC15/failed DC20 preserved; no extra roll because clarifying terms of commander's existing counterproposal, no actual key demand withdrawn yet. Elara and Cirren witness. D315~14:32 Caereth guildhall side chamber, V/Elara/Cirren with private defense commander, Mara/Fenar outside. V asks whether commander will withdraw armory-key demand if V secures guild agreement to lawful rapid equipment release. Commander voluntarily confirms conditional commitment: if guild accepts a quartermaster or authorized deputy on duty, a mutually agreed mobilization protocol and prompt issue only of explicitly authorized equipment under actual lawful authority, he will rescind his signed unilateral key/stock-control demand and publicly confirm guild custody at the 16:00 meeting. He will hold off enforcing the demand while V obtains guild response. This is conditional, not actual rescission or acceptance by guild, no unconditional concession beyond previous DC15 result. Elara/Cirren witness promise. No V commitment beyond question, no new expense, roll, combat or reward. Quartermaster holds keys and documents. V may take proposal to organizer/quartermaster.
